text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on species distribution modeling of the camel tick Hyalomma dromedarii using MaxEnt. Although it uses land use/land cover (LULC) as an input variable (contributing 53.1% to model suitability), LULC prediction or simulation is not the primary objective. The study does not predict or simulate future LULC changes; instead, it assumes LULC remains static and excludes it in future climate projections. Furthermore, it fails multiple core inclusion criteria: (1) it does not implement LULC prediction as its central research question, (2) it does not include ≥2 future LULC scenarios (only climate scenarios under ssp2-4.5 are used, with LULC held constant), and (3) outputs are tick habitat suitability maps, not mapped LULC projections. The focus is ecological/species-specific, which aligns with exclusion criterion "Species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC.")
